messages:
maria: Quick design sync Eval run modal final tweaks. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz - two CTA options in the mock: primary `Run suite` + secondary `Quick run` (preview). Thoughts on copy and accidental runs? jay: I like `Run suite` as primary. can we add a tiny helper line under the CTA: 'Estimated time: ~2m Estimated cost: $0.05' so users see impact before clicking. oliver: Agree on helper line. also propose a conditional confirmation for large suites (>500 prompts OR >$5). show a checkbox "I understand this will consume credits" to prevent accidental big jobs. kira: Accessibility nits: secondary button contrast fails AA in the current mock; focus ring is getting clipped in dark theme. focus order looks wrong too (close X appears after CTAs in DOM). Also ensure cancel has reachable touch target size. design-bot: lint: color-contrast issue on .secondary-btn (contrast 3.8:1). recommend #475569 or bold 600 weight. maria: Updated copy proposal: primary: `Run suite` (aria-label="Run the selected test suite"), helper line (muted): "Estimated time: ~2m Estimated cost: $0.05". Big-run inline warning: "This run will process 1,200 prompts and may take about 30 minutes. Estimated cost: $12.00." jay: For keyboard users add a keyboard hint in header: "Press R to run" and ensure `R` doesn't conflict elsewhere. Escape should close modal and return focus to origin button. kira: Add aria-live="polite" to helper line so screen readers announce ETA/cost on open. role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and a visible focus trap required. honor prefers-reduced-motion for progress visuals. oliver: Conditional confirm logic: show checkbox only when prompts_count > 500 OR estimated_cost_usd > 5. add telemetry events: eval_run_confirm_shown and eval_run_confirm_accepted. maria: Implementation snippet for devs:

Estimated time: ~2m Estimated cost: $0.05

jay: Telemetry naming: use eval_run_initiated and eval_run_confirmation with props suite_id, prompts_count, estimated_cost_usd. data infra to map. kira: Copy tweak: sentence case for helper line. big-run messaging should be plain language and avoid parentheses. also ensure cancel button label is `Cancel` not `Abort`. maria: UX decision: keep `Quick run` preview button that runs a 5-prompt sample via endpoint param preview=true. show small `Preview` badge on the button. will add analytics eval_run_preview_used. oliver: Backend ok with preview flag. Devs: add feature flag to control the checkbox threshold if we tune later. kira: Final accessibility checklist before handoff: 1) AA contrast 2) keyboard focus trap and order 3) screen reader announces ETA/cost 4) touch targets >=44px 5) reduced motion respected. maria: I'll update Figma and open a dev ticket with copy, aria attrs, thresholds, and telemetry. plz react :thumbsup: if you approve or drop inline comments. thanks! :sparkles:
